app.title: Usenet rewind archive search engine
app.author: cstadler1869
app.description: A web-based search interface for accessing archived Usenet discussions.
proposed_tests: Access the main page and verify search form renders
Search for a known thread keyword and check that results appear
Use the API endpoint (if available) to query a specific thread ID
Measure response time for a typical search query
Check that pagination works for a query with many results
